decision: Electrical safety circuit should stop charging the hot battery. A charger being defective remains an explicitly unsupported alternative explanation; do not claim it actually failed.
A dropped network connection is insufficient to prove the server suffered a cyberattack; a cyberattack remains logically possible but unasserted.
Researchers should rule out instrumental noise as an alternate explanation; a signal from an extraterrestrial civilization is not established by a faint telescope detection.
A contract being unsigned cannot alone demonstrate that it becomes automatically void; jurisdictional law and other validity requirements are not inferred.
